rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched a single user, and operated only on that user’s account. It identified the pending order sent to the DC address, sought explicit confirmation before updating the shipping address to the Charlotte default, then executed the change successfully. For item modifications, the agent used read-only product tools to surface valid variants, obtained explicit confirmation (including specifying the exact variants and the payment method for any price difference), and executed the change with the correct order ID, item IDs, and the confirmed PayPal method. Final information reflected the successful updates and correct shipping address. Minor concern: the agent stated the order status string and that a charge occurred without explicit tool confirmation, but this does not undermine the core compliance with authentication, confirmation before writes, and correct execution of changes.
